purpose: Audit linked-panel data and establish a statistical reference before selecting another learned predictor.

endpoint.construct: Seven-category party identification; observed survey response

design.primary_scope: Unweighted, observed-endpoint linked cohort; not the 2024 electorate
design.transfer_claim: Later-wave prediction for known panel members
design.development_partition: SHA256(anes-panel-development-v1: + linked_person_id) modulo 5; all records of a person stay together
design.partition_limit: Source PSU/household dependencies require a separate grouping review before inferential use; five folds are not five temporal replications.
design.primary_task: One-step conditional prediction from the observed input wave
design.raw_reference: New seven-by-seven Laplace-one transition table fitted only on authorized development pairs
design.primary_metric: Mean normalized RPS across six ordinal cuts
design.stability_metric: Change-event Brier score from 1 minus predicted probability of the initial category
design.missing_targets: Exclude from scored endpoint pairs with reason counts; never impute truth or map missing codes to category four
design.later_inputs: Initial party ID at 2020 pre only; additional features require a separately verified and frozen schema
design.history_ablation: Deferred: only one earlier observed transition supports development

stage_order: Retain existing DEBATE reference separately; never reuse its six-category coefficients for ANES
Archive official source documentation and resolve endpoint construction, release and column mappings
Freeze a trusted raw-to-development projection; keep later outcomes outside the development export
Audit linkage, missingness, attrition, modes and development fold support
Assess development precision and define one candidate, practical margin and uncertainty plan
Freeze predictor, fit data, later input whitelist and complete predictions before evaluating later outcomes
